title: Guest reviews
verification: How are reviews verified? Only a guest who booked on this platform and completed their stay can write a review, once per booking. Reviews containing profanity or personal information are checked before publication; reviews that exceed the report threshold are hidden. No payment or incentive is given for reviews; negative reviews are published too.
